features: 📱 TURN WIRED AUDIO WIRELESS: Add Bluetooth connectivity to compatible car stereos, home audio systems, wired headphones and speakers through a standard 3.5mm AUX connection. Enjoy wireless music, podcasts and other audio from your compatible Bluetooth-enabled device without replacing your existing audio equipment.

🚗 IDEAL FOR CAR & HOME AUDIO: Connect the receiver to your car AUX port or compatible home audio equipment and stream audio wirelessly from your smartphone or other Bluetooth-enabled device. A convenient way to upgrade compatible wired audio setups for everyday listening and road trips.

🎤 BUILT-IN MIC FOR HANDS-FREE CALLS: The integrated microphone supports hands-free conversations when the receiver is connected to a compatible audio system. Convenient for taking calls while driving or multitasking, helping you stay connected without repeatedly handling your phone.

🔋 UP TO 8–10 HOURS PLAYBACK & TALK TIME: Enjoy up to 8–10 hours of continuous playback or talk time on a single charge. Recharge the receiver with the included USB cable so it is ready for everyday listening, commuting and travel.
